name: botfiles
description: A curated collection of Claude Code plugins for Zig, Elixir/Phoenix, infrastructure operations, and developer workflow tools.

plugins.name: zig-dev
plugins.description: Zig development skills: style enforcement, memory leak detection, safety checking, error handling, and API reference.

plugins.name: elixir-phoenix
plugins.description: Elixir and Phoenix development skills: framework guidelines, LiveView patterns, Ecto best practices, HEEx templates, testing, and Tailwind CSS v4.

plugins.name: infra-ops
plugins.description: Infrastructure operations skills: Terraform safety, Docker Swarm patterns, Ansible operations, and repeatable deployment philosophy.

plugins.name: bees-issue-tracker
plugins.description: Local-first issue tracking with the bees CLI — issues as a committed issues.jsonl, epics with dependencies, and the in_progress -> closed lifecycle.

plugins.name: commit-message-guide
plugins.description: Well-structured conventional commits — type(scope): subject in imperative mood, bodies only when they add value, and no AI attribution.

plugins.name: mise
plugins.description: Using mise (mise-en-place) for tool-version management, task running, and environment config via mise.toml.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: A personal cross-codebase development workflow composing the mise, bees-issue-tracker, and commit-message-guide skills with Git.
